fields.name: company_id
fields.label: Company
fields.help: Let this field empty if this location is shared between companies

fields.name: location_id
fields.label: Parent Location
fields.help: The parent location that includes this location. Example : The 'Dispatch Zone' is the 'Gate 1' parent location.

fields.name: active
fields.label: Active
fields.help: By unchecking the active field, you may hide a location without deleting it.

fields.name: usage
fields.label: Location Type
fields.help:
* Vendor Location: Virtual location representing the source location for products coming from your vendors
* View: Virtual location used to create a hierarchical structures for your warehouse, aggregating its child locations ; can't directly contain products
* Internal Location: Physical locations i

fields.name: scrap_location
fields.label: Is a Scrap Location?
fields.help: Check this box to allow using this location to put scrapped/damaged goods.

fields.name: replenish_location
fields.label: Replenish Location
fields.help: Activate this function to get all quantities to replenish at this particular location

fields.name: cyclic_inventory_frequency
fields.label: Inventory Frequency
fields.help: When different than 0, inventory count date for products stored at this location will be automatically set at the defined frequency.

fields.name: last_inventory_date
fields.label: Last Inventory
fields.help: Date of the last inventory at this location.

fields.name: next_inventory_date
fields.label: Next Expected
fields.help: Date for next planned inventory based on cyclic schedule.
